mostWorthwhile.text: Following glucose into storage and back into the blood was most worthwhile: it showed how the liver helps supply cells between meals.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the vein was the least engaging part; it was a straightforward connection without much new explanation.

surprise.text: The store shrinking as glucose entered the blood made the between-meal supply clearer. The stored carbohydrate still wasn't named.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, but connecting the vein and then the body were the only offered combinations at those points, so they felt more like assembly than meaningful choices.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see how the connected body works, though I'd hope for more choices like following the glucose store and fewer simple fittings.
